purpose: Bind the scheduled citywide address-index refresh to every committed derived artifact that declares the refreshed geography inputs and is re-checked with a --check drift gate. The rebuild sequence runs after the PAD snapshot, in dependency order, and published_paths is the only list the workflow may stage.

published_paths.reason: Official PAD snapshot shards and manifest produced by the address-index builder.
Meeting-geography generation activated by the address-geography refresh.
Resident meeting read model restamped when meeting-geography memberships change.
Parcel-point and membership shards recomputed when PAD content or boundaries change.
Active Land project-lot geography membership index invalidated when parcel memberships change.
Per-project Land place evidence shards that travel with the active membership index.
Immutable Land place generation tree, ACTIVE pointer, and refresh receipt published with the membership rebuild.

rebuild_sequence.note: Parcel membership changes invalidate Land project-lot joins. The refresh publishes one coherent generation and mirrors it into the active membership index and evidence shards that build_land_place_membership.mjs --check re-derives.
